title: Tuple Assignment: Fibonacci & GCD
hints: Tuple assignment evaluates the right side fully before assigning.

`(x, y) = (y, x + y)` for Fibonacci and `(p, q) = (q, p % q)` for GCD.
jsBridge: `(a, b) = (b, a + b)` updates both at once with no temporary variable. JS array destructuring `[a, b] = [b, a + b]` does the same, but allocates an array, while Swift tuples are free.
